name: quota-handoff
description: Tells Claude Code to stop, write a handoff document, commit and push once per session when the 5-hour or weekly subscription quota left drops below 10%, so work isn't cut off halfway.

five_hour_remaining.title: 5-hour threshold (% left)
five_hour_remaining.description: Hand off when the 5-hour quota left is below this percentage. 0 turns this window off.

week_remaining.title: Weekly threshold (% left)
week_remaining.description: Hand off when the weekly quota left is below this percentage. 0 turns this window off.

handoff_file.title: Handoff document
handoff_file.description: Path of the handoff document, relative to the project root.

push.title: Push after committing
push.description: Push the handoff commit to the branch's remote. Turn off to commit locally only.

auto_setup.title: Set up automatically
auto_setup.description: Wire the status line at the first session start, keeping the one you had. Turn off to do it yourself with /quota-handoff:setup.
